summary: John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 30, 2026 it became party to and assumed obligations under the JPM Funding Facility, a Loan and Security Agreement dated March 26, 2024, following its acquisition of Manulife Private Credit Fund. The facility involves Manulife Private Credit Fund SPV, LLC as borrower, BNY Mellon as collateral agent and administrative intermediary, and JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent. The Fund also declared September 2026 dividends, with Class I shares paying $0.1807 per share, implying an 8.64% annualized distribution yield. No special-situations event.
